title: PIXL 8000 Cola Lime Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Cola Lime from PIXL 8000 blends the familiar sweetness of classic Cola with a zesty squeeze of Lime for a refreshing vape with citrus lift. The fizzy soda base is balanced with a twist of tang to keep things lively. Prefilled with 2ml of 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and supplied with a 10ml refill reservoir, this pod delivers up to 8000 puffs when used with the PIXL 8000 Prefilled Pod Vape Kit. Mesh coil technology ensures consistent flavour and vapour throughout. Designed for MTL vaping with draw-activation and Boost Mode support, this pod offers a simple, satisfying experience. Cola Lime is a great pick for vapers looking for something familiar yet playful.
